parts.label: a
parts.technique: impulse-momentum for a particle
parts.reason: Impulse and momentum are not mentioned in any M-section statement (M6-M9 only cover units, kinematics, Newton's laws/forces, moments); no statement covers impulse or momentum concept.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: conservation of linear momentum
parts.reason: Momentum/CLM is not covered by any listed statement.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Newton's second law, connected system (lift) vertical motion
parts.reason: M8.2 covers Newton's second law for straight-line motion with forces resolved; M8.3 covers weight and motion under gravity. Lift/tension problem with system equation is standard application.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Newton's second law for a particle (woman) in lift, normal reaction
parts.reason: Same as above; M8.1 covers normal reaction, M8.2 Newton's second law.

parts.label: main
parts.technique: resolving forces on inclined plane with friction, limiting equilibrium
parts.reason: M8.4 guidance explicitly includes connected particles/forces resolved on an inclined plane; M8.6 covers F≤μR friction model and limiting friction/statics. This is a standard equilibrium-with-friction-on-incline problem.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: constant acceleration suvat formula
parts.reason: M7.3 covers constant acceleration formulae for straight-line motion.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: constant acceleration suvat, solving quadratic for time
parts.reason: M7.3 covers suvat formulae; solving resulting quadratic uses P2.3 (in spec). Straightforward extension of constant acceleration kinematics.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: speed-time graph sketching
parts.reason: M7.2 covers interpreting/using graphs in kinematics for motion in a straight line, including sketching.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: area under speed-time graph (trapezium) to find distance
parts.reason: M7.2 covers area under velocity-time graph as distance.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: area under speed-time graph, motorcycle motion, solving for time
parts.reason: Same kinematics graph-area technique as M7.2; uses only kinematics motion in straight line.

parts.label: d
parts.technique: constant acceleration formula (uniform acceleration from rest)
parts.reason: M7.3 covers constant acceleration formulae.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: moments about a support for a rigid beam, tilting equilibrium
parts.reason: 'centre of mass' is explicitly listed as a concept no statement covers, making it OUT despite M9.1 covering moments in simple static contexts; this problem requires centre of mass reasoning for a non-uniform beam.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: moments equilibrium with centre of mass, equal reactions
parts.reason: Depends on answer from part (a) (mass and centre-of-mass position found there) and continues to require centre of mass concept, which is explicitly excluded.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: vector velocity, magnitude (speed) calculation
parts.reason: P10.1/P10.2 cover vectors in two dimensions and calculating magnitude; velocity as a vector application is covered via M7.3/kinematics context. This is basic vector magnitude, in spec.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: bearing from velocity vector components
parts.reason: Finding direction (bearing) from vector components is part of magnitude/direction conversion (P10.2) applied to vectors in mechanics context (M7.3/M8.5 use vector direction).

parts.label: c(i)
parts.technique: parallel vector condition (component equals zero)
parts.reason: P10.3 covers parallel vectors and vector operations; finding when a vector is parallel to a unit vector via component condition is standard vector work.

parts.label: c(ii)
parts.technique: parallel vector condition, solving equation for t
parts.reason: Same as above, P10.3 parallel vectors; solving linear equation is basic algebra.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Newton's second law, connected particles over pulley
parts.reason: M8.4 guidance explicitly covers 'application to problems involving smooth pulleys and connected particles'.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: tension in string, connected particles
parts.reason: Follows directly from in-spec pulley/connected particles work covered by M8.4.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: resultant force on pulley from two string tensions (vector addition of forces at right angles)
parts.reason: M8.5 covers addition of forces/resultant forces and resolving; finding resultant of two tensions at 90° using Pythagoras/resolving is standard application.
